title: Remove Element
audience: Candidates refreshing in-place array interview questions
objective: Remove a target value in-place; return k and keep valid values in nums[0..k-1]. The tail is ignored.
constraints: 0 <= n <= 100000; signed 32-bit integers; target: 1 second; O(1) extra space
callToAction: Comment the returned length and valid prefix.

narration.hook: Remove the target in place. Return the number of kept values.
narration.setup: Read pointer R checks values. Write pointer W marks the next kept slot.
narration.zero: Skip the target. Advance only read pointer R.
narration.swap: Keep {value}. Swap it forward, then advance both pointers.
narration.summary: Return write pointer W as the length. Ignore all slots after the valid prefix.
narration.challenge: Remove three. What length and prefix should you return?
